name: field
description: A text field. Single line by default; a textarea in the auth forms and the entry editor, a select in the auth forms. Never autofocused. In the no-script comps a div stands in for it, its hint shown as a placeholder.

form.description: account: a field in the account forms (was .auth-field): a textarea or select is a block with the form's padding, and a refused value (invalid) shows --w-alert in --action-delete. editor: the entry editor's textarea (was .entry-editor): a block, three --ctl tall, --s6 padding, resized vertically. bare (v4 C1): the input inside the Timeline's search pill, which draws the box, the focus ring and the magnifier itself: no border, no ground, no ring of its own; it fills its row's height, --s4 either side, its placeholder --rule-2.

invalid.description: The value was refused (aria-invalid="true"). In the auth forms the border becomes --w-alert in --action-delete.

placeholder.description: The comps' stand-in shows its hint in --rule-2 (was .field.placeholder). Real fields use the placeholder attribute instead.

tag.description: div only in the no-script comps.

value.description: The person's own words, or the hint when placeholder is on.

label.description: The accessible name: a visible label in the forms, aria-label in the composer.

options.description: A select's options: { value, label, selected }.

states.focus-visible: yes: the box's own border, 2px in --block, drawn inward (--w-focus: a 1px outline just inside the 1px border); nothing outside the box is covered; a refused value keeps its 2px --action-delete
states.active: n/a: a field is not pressed
states.disabled: n/a: fields are never disabled; an unavailable action is not shown
states.loading: n/a: a field is never waiting
states.error: yes: aria-invalid="true" in the auth forms takes the alert border, --w-alert in --action-delete; the message is written under the field (the auth help line)

changelog.change: Converted from lock.css E3 (.field) and its auth-form, password and entry-editor contexts.
The error state is drawn in colour as well as weight: --w-alert in --action-delete (was a 2px border in the field colour).
Fixture Composer, the composer field the guide samples.
The placeholder flag is written bare (data-placeholder), as the screens and the generators that read it have it.
An input writes aria-label and value only when given: an auth field is named by its label element (13-login).
Content options for a select ([{ value, label, selected }]: 17's timezone list); a select names itself by aria-label only when given. Pages round 4b.
The bare form (v4 C1): the Timeline search pill's input.

v4 round 10: focus is the field's own border at 2px in --block, drawn inward, not a ring outside it (it covered Forgot your password on sign in); a refused value keeps its red. The live composer's textarea (no form) centres its line in the box (padding-block from --ctl and 1lh).
